appenzell-schw-galp-toggenburg-classic-a.title: Appenzell · Schwägalp · Toggenburg Classic + Brünig · Glaubenbielen · Entlebuch Flow
appenzell-schw-galp-toggenburg-classic-a.slogan: Two days · overnight at Rapperswil · one way

waypoints.name: Rapperswil lake bridge
waypoints.advice: Rapperswil lake bridge is where the day begins. Next is Appenzell old town, climbing 372 m.

waypoints.name: Appenzell old town
waypoints.advice: Appenzell old town is where this day stops to eat. The road climbs 372 m over at least 46 km before it, steadily. Reckon on about 2 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Schwägalp Säntis road, climbing 498 m.

waypoints.name: Schwägalp Säntis road
waypoints.advice: 1278 m, and the road stops climbing. The road climbs 498 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Toggenburg flow road, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Toggenburg flow road
waypoints.advice: Toggenburg flow road, early in the day at 800 m. You lose 478 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 3 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Walensee photo line, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Walensee photo line
waypoints.advice: Walensee photo line sits at 131 km, about halfway. You lose 381 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Back to Rapperswil.

waypoints.name: Back to Rapperswil
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 393 km. Next is Lucerne lake.

waypoints.name: Lucerne lake exit
waypoints.advice: 197 km in you reach Lucerne lake. Next is Entlebuch food stop, climbing 287 m.

waypoints.name: Entlebuch food stop
waypoints.advice: Somewhere to get off the bike, 229 km in. The road climbs 287 m on the way up to it, steadily. Next is Glaubenbielen high road, climbing 888 m.

waypoints.name: Glaubenbielen high road
waypoints.advice: The high point of this section, 1611 m up. The road climbs 888 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 8 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Brünigpass sweepers, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Brünigpass sweepers
waypoints.advice: Brünigpass sweepers tops the climb at 1008 m. You lose 603 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 4 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Giswil, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Giswil fuel gate
waypoints.advice: Fill up here — 65 km left and no pump marked after this. You lose 523 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Zug lake return.

waypoints.name: Zug lake return
waypoints.advice: Zug lake return, late in the day at 413 m. Next is Back to Lucerne lake.

waypoints.name: Back to Lucerne lake exit
waypoints.advice: Back to Lucerne lake closes the day.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 16 km. 498 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: 478 m come off over 10 km at around 5.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Appenzell and Schwagalp Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 16 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Emmental Panorama Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1611 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grimsel Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: 14 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

appenzell-schw-galp-toggenburg-classic-a.story: A one-way ride of 383 km, Rapperswil to Luzern - roughly 7 h 32 in the saddle. The stops in between: Appenzell old town, Toggenburg flow road and Walensee  line. The climbs: Schwägalp Säntis road, Glaubenbielen high road and Brünigpass sweepers. It tops out at 1,611 m. Brunig Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: For 37 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Ropshinskoe Highway → The Palace and Park Ensembles of the Town
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 35 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
